summary: Google DeepMind published a routine version release (v2.3.0) of the Concordia agent-based simulation library, with bug fixes, refactors, new prefabs and documentation.

practices.reason: New game master prefabs and scene-aware event delivery are agent-simulation scaffolding a team could look at, but they are under-specified library changes rather than a described technique with a stated gain.
practices.quote: Add physically situated and dramaturgic game master prefab. This prefab is similar to the situated_in_time_and_place prefab, but with scenes added in.

practices.reason: Deprecated files were removed and action spec parsing changed to JSON, which could break code depending on the old format.
practices.quote: Changed action spec parsing to json for more robustness than string matching
